notes: 1. All the interrupt events can wake up the system from Sleep mode at each instance. For detailed information about instances capabilities to exit from concrete Stop and Standby mode refer to the Functionalities depending on the working mode table.
2. Refer to Section45.3: SPI implementation for information about Standby mode availability.
3. The TXC flag behavior depends on the TSIZE setting. When TSIZE>0, the flag fully follows the EOT one including its clearing by EOTC.
